schema: workflow/v1
id: doc-fanout
name: 文档并行版
summary: 研究后两人并行撰写，汇总后人工确认
entry: T-001
terminal: T-006
nodes:
  - id: T-001
    node_type: role
    role: researcher
    title: 研究
    timeout: 600
    retry: 2
    wake_allow: [writer, editor]
    outputs: [research.notes]
  - id: T-002
    node_type: role
    role: writer
    title: 撰写A
    parallel_scope: draft
    scope: draft-a
    inputs: [brief]
  - id: T-003
    node_type: role
    role: editor
    title: 撰写B
    parallel_scope: draft
    scope: draft-b
    inputs: [brief]
  - id: T-004
    node_type: human
    title: 人工确认
  - id: T-005
    node_type: escalate
    title: 升级
  - id: T-006
    node_type: subworkflow
    workflow: code-loop
    title: 代码闭环
edges:
  - from: T-001
    to: T-002
    map:
      - from: T-001.research.notes
        to: brief
  - from: T-001
    to: T-003
    map:
      - from: T-001.research.notes
        to: brief
  - from: T-002
    to: T-004
  - from: T-003
    to: T-004
  - from: T-004
    to: T-006
    when: human_approved
  - from: T-004
    to: T-005
    when: human_rejected
  - from: T-006
    to: T-005
    when: failed

commands.stdout: 校验工作流 4 个：全部通过
